notes.title: Prologue fixes and improvements
notes.content:
[h2][b]Prologue fixes and improvements v0.18[/b][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43034943/4d6695f8f6848c3f9c2ab22b9bedc75740391156.png[/img]


[h3][list]
[*] Increased number of items in one stack to 32
[*] Changed monsters AI not to attack the player through walls
[*] Now fuel won't decay when there are no items in furnace
[*] Notifications of picked up items
[*] Fixed a bug where monsters could spawn on floors, when the player was in underground at night
[*] Better UI scaling for different resolutions
[*] Fixed a bug where tooltips could cover items on some resolutions & UI scale combinations
[*] Fixed a bug where you could duplicate saddled alpacas
[*] Fixed a bug where you could place biomes in the underground
[*] Changed couple of objects that farmer goblin likes
[*] Other improvements
[/list][/h3]

notes.title: FULL VERSION | RELEASE DATE! 🤩
notes.content:
[h1][b]Minilanders! 🙌[/b][/h1]

[h3]Get ready for the full launch in April! 🔥[/h3]

[h3]We are launching the full version of the game at:[/h3]
[h1][b]April 10, 2023! 🥳[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]You can wishlist now to get a notification when the game is released!👇😊[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland_Adventure/

[b]We would like to thank you very much for all your feedback and bug reports.[/b] We have most of the things you mentioned already done for the full game, we are working on finishing some stuff at the moment and will be ready with the release on [b]April 10, 2023[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland_Adventure/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43034943/fc20b077192ae623af4cb8f0802841ae429ac6cb.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Soon we will present you most of the upcoming changes compared to the full version of the game, but here is a list of a few of them:[/h3][list][*] creating multiple worlds,
[*] difficulty levels,
[*] game mode,
[*] save system,
[*] no limit to the number of days,
[*] the ability to create a portal and access a completely new location with new biomes, monsters, and resources,
[*] ...[/list][b]And definitely more things! We'll be bringing you the full list soon! [/b]


[h3][b]So get ready now and save the date - [u]April 10, 2023[/u]! 🗓️[/b][/h3]

[url=https://discord.gg/6m9NW8DkDx][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/732e78bb6bb96f2dcf7dd9ba3563963474b96e82.png[/img][/url]

See you very soon,
Miniland Team

notes.title: UPDATE | Patch 1.1 🧰
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Minilanders 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3][b]It's been 4 days since the release of the game's prologue, [u]we would like to thank you all for your commitment, feedback, and opinion about the game.[/u] 🤝[/b][/h3]

[h3]For the last 4 days, we have been busy writing down bugs or things that you think should be improved and right now you can download Patch 1.1![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43034943/ed636bcf6178e5e1dec3bc3c639043db48b9d019.png[/img]

[h3][b]Patch 1.1 | Changelog[/b][/h3]

[b]1️⃣. Subtracting some food after drinking salt water:[/b]
Our little oversight - now after drinking salt water, hunger will be increased.

[b]2️⃣. Fixed a bug that caused the same music to play over and over again.[/b]
By accident, after finishing the song, instead of a new song, the same one was played again and again. Now we have fixed that. 

[b]3️⃣. Added missing "è" characters in French.[/b]
Thanks to the French community for reporting this!

[b]4️⃣. Improved visibility of all texts.[/b]

[b]5️⃣. Added option to disable screen shake.[/b]

[b]6️⃣. Reduced movement of menu items.[/b]

[b]7️⃣. Fixes in the tutorial.[/b]

[b]8️⃣. Now on the third day we have a ladder.[/b]

[b]9️⃣. Slightly changed biome selection system:[/b]
Now instead of choosing a biome every day that we get 8 pieces, you will get 4 pieces of the selected biome and 4 pieces of the biome matched to the world.

Thank you one more time!
Miniland Adventure Team
